text: The calculator shall support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/) as arithmetic operations.
source_quote: - Support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/).

text: The calculator shall accept a single arithmetic expression as an argument and print the result.
source_quote: I want a command-line calculator that accepts one arithmetic expression as an argument and prints the result.

text: Accept nonnegative integer operands, including zero.
source_quote: - Accept nonnegative integer operands, including zero.

text: Apply standard arithmetic precedence: parentheses first, multiplication and division next, then addition and subtraction.
source_quote: - Apply standard arithmetic precedence: parentheses first, multiplication and division next, then addition and subtraction.

text: Evaluate operators of equal precedence from left to right.
source_quote: - Evaluate operators of equal precedence from left to right.

text: Accept expressions with or without spaces between numbers and operators.
source_quote: - Accept expressions with or without spaces between numbers and operators.

text: Print integer results without a decimal point or unnecessary leading zeros.
source_quote: - Print integer results without a decimal point or unnecessary leading zeros.

text: Print fractional results in decimal notation without unnecessary trailing zeros.
source_quote: - Print fractional results in decimal notation without unnecessary trailing zeros.

text: For division, this initial evaluation only requires cases whose exact results have terminating decimal representations.
source_quote: - For division, this initial evaluation only requires cases whose exact results have terminating decimal representations.

text: Print only the result on standard output, followed by a newline.
source_quote: - Print only the result on standard output, followed by a newline.

text: Exit with status 0 after a successful calculation.
source_quote: - Exit with status 0 after a successful calculation.
